arguments.name: model
arguments.help: Hugging Face model ID or local snapshot

arguments.name: precision
arguments.help: Compute precision (default: fp16 for paired execution, bf16 otherwise)

arguments.name: max_sequence_length
arguments.help: KV cache length in tokens, the longest prompt plus generation (default: the smaller of the checkpoint context and 4096; with the dynamic prefill engine at least --prefill-chunk-len)

arguments.name: prefill_chunk_len
arguments.help: Prompt tokens per multi-token prefill engine call (0 = single-token prefill). Static engine: default 128. Dynamic engine: the largest call, default 1024

arguments.name: prefill_engine
arguments.help: Prefill engine: dynamic takes any token count from 1 to --prefill-chunk-len (default 1024) in one call and needs the cuTile GDN plugin, fp16 or bf16, and no MTP engines; static takes a fixed --prefill-chunk-len (default 128) per call; auto (default) builds the dynamic engine when it is available and otherwise the static one, printing the reason

arguments.name: prefill_opt_len
arguments.help: Token count the dynamic prefill engine is tuned for (default 256)

arguments.name: mtp_seq_len
arguments.help: Build the embedded MTP engines (the checkpoint must have MTP weights); N = 1 real token + N-1 drafted tokens verified per round, N >= 2. Without this option no MTP engines are built.

arguments.name: execution_variant
arguments.help: Explicit execution mode; MTP uses an embedded draft, external companions are explicit
